title: IG-RUEQFT locality audit research graph
description: A repository-local memory and index graph for the scoped IG-RUEQFT information-gauge locality audit. It separates the external proposal, one finite free-fermion oracle, its negative locality result, and the still-open interacting and continuum questions without treating the oracle as a general refutation of the full programme.

quick_answers.question: Did U(1) group averaging make the recorded entanglement term a bulk-local density?
quick_answers.answer: No in the frozen N=64 free-fermion oracle. The upper bound on the charge-dephased entropy divided by L squared falls from 0.4520 at L=4 to 0.1475 at L=16, while the entropy remains compatible with log-enhanced boundary scaling rather than volume scaling.

quick_answers.question: Does that one oracle refute all of IG-RUEQFT?
quick_answers.answer: No general verdict is established. The calculation is a finite free U(1) model and does not implement the proposal's interacting matter action, information-gauge field, continuum stress tensor, renormalization, or empirical predictions.

nodes.title: Charge group averaging makes the recorded entanglement term bulk local
nodes.statement: In the frozen N=64 free-U(1) oracle, charge-sector group averaging changes the entanglement contribution into an extensive bulk density whose entropy-to-volume ratio remains approximately constant as L grows from 4 to 16.
nodes.summary: Contradicted in the declared finite model: even the computed upper bracket for the dephased entropy divided by L squared falls strongly with L, while the unaveraged entropy remains compatible with log-enhanced boundary scaling.

nodes.title: The recorded charge-dephased entropy remains subvolume
nodes.statement: For every sampled L in the frozen free-fermion oracle, the exact bracket S_A <= S_inv <= S_A + H(P_A) has an upper entropy-to-volume ratio that decreases across the scan, from 0.4519503958 at L=4 to 0.1474721981 at L=16.
nodes.summary: Supported as a finite numerical statement. It is evidence against the tested bulk-density shortcut, not a continuum asymptotic theorem.

nodes.title: The single free oracle refutes the full IG-RUEQFT programme
nodes.statement: The frozen free-U(1) calculation alone is sufficient to reject every interacting, continuum, gauge-completed, or phenomenological realization of IG-RUEQFT.
nodes.summary: Not established. The recorded result blocks the displayed group-averaging locality shortcut in one free model, while proposal-specific dynamics and broader universality remain untested.

nodes.title: Finite free-fermion charge-dephasing locality oracle
nodes.summary: The committed result records seven region sizes. S_A/L squared falls from 0.345408 to 0.137253 and the exact upper bracket (S_A+H)/L squared falls from 0.451950 to 0.147472; S_A/(L log L) changes from 0.901892 at L=6 to 0.792055 at L=16. These observed finite trends contradict the registered volume-scaling predicate without proving a continuum theorem.

nodes.title: Build a continuum interacting locality discriminator
nodes.summary: The finite free-model trend is decisive only for its registered shortcut; a broader test needs controlled size scaling, interactions, gauge constraints, and a local stress-tensor or renormalization criterion.
nodes.question: Does a proposal-specific interacting continuum construction change the subvolume entropy bound or instead reproduce the same nonlocal boundary dependence?
